They are mobile launchers, with the same concealment, exposure after firing and shoot-and-scoot rules as the shore-based missiles; 1 shot per phase, land targets only: rockets reach 4 tiles (about 80 km, hit on 4+), ATACMS tactical missiles reach 14 tiles (about 300 km, hit on 5+, using 0.5 point of the long-range missile stock), +1 against targets in cities or mountains, and a hit costs the target 1 step.
